Five assertion strings and one fixture follow the vocabulary: `skill_invoked` → `SkillInvoked` (599, 647), `tool_use` → `ToolUse` in the negative that pins an event naming no declared member out of the denominator (603), `instructions_loaded` → `InstructionsLoaded` (2198), the comment naming both spellings (570), and the lone telemetry fixture declaring a snake_case event (679) — `events: vec!["skill_invoked"]` is a name `roster.rs`'s admissibility judge refuses, green today only because the absent-log test reads the declaration as a boolean. Every other telemetry fixture in the tree already spells the documented name (1872, 1963, 2016, 2066, 2108; src/roster.rs:694).

summary: explain's two telemetry strands spell the tap event set two ways; the field strand's hand-written snake_case table dies and both narrate the documented name
